name: Ember Brand
description: A forge-blackened sword whose fuller still glows when it is drawn.

skill.name: Kindle
skill.text: Set an enemy Burning for two rounds.

name: Mirefang Dagger
description: A marsh-hunter's knife with a hooked, serrated back.

skill.name: Hamstring
skill.text: Slow an enemy for two rounds: 2 less armour.

name: Hexwood Rod
description: Pale hexwood bound in silver wire that unpicks a ward's knots.
purpose: Equip: +1 spell attack bonus, +1 spell save DC.

skill.name: Unravel
skill.text: Make an enemy Vulnerable until your next turn: it takes 25% more damage.

name: Bulwark Shield
description: A tall, iron-rimmed shield that needs a strong arm to hold steady.
purpose: Equip in your off hand for +2 Armor Class. Cannot be used with a two-handed weapon.

skill.name: Brace
skill.text: Become Fortified until your next turn: take 25% less damage.

name: Warden's Signet
description: The roadwardens' seal ring, given to those who have kept the road.

story.text: Advantage on the first Insight check after each long rest.

name: Veilstep Cloak
description: Grey wool that takes on the colour of whatever wall it brushes.
purpose: Equip in the accessory slot for +1 AC.

story.text: Advantage on the first Stealth check after each long rest.

name: Oathbound Mail
description: Plate links stamped with the oaths of the wardens who wore it before you.
